audit_items.proof_trace: The POST handler generates the plaintext secret locally, hashes it via `hashClientSecret` (bcrypt cost 10), and passes only `p_client_secret_hash` to the `create_application` RPC — no plaintext parameter is sent to the DB. The plaintext is returned once in the HTTP response body by design and is never logged; the `OAuthClientList` Application interface excludes any secret field, confirming no re-fetch path exists.
